question: In January 2025, what practice did the Supreme Court of India order to be completely stopped in six major metropolitan cities?

options.text: Manual scavenging and hazardous sewer cleaning

solution:
The correct answer is __**Manual scavenging and hazardous sewer cleaning**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Manual scavenging**, the practice of cleaning human excreta by hand, has been banned in India under the **Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and Their Rehabilitation Act, 2013**.

• Despite the ban, instances of manual scavenging and hazardous sewer cleaning persist, especially in metropolitan cities, leading to severe health risks and fatalities.

• On **January 2025**, the **Supreme Court of India** ordered the complete cessation of manual scavenging and hazardous sewer cleaning in **six major metropolitan cities**, emphasizing the use of mechanized cleaning methods.

• The Court highlighted the urgent need to enforce mechanization and technological advancements to ensure the dignity, safety, and well-being of sanitation workers.
